the_two_gates.outcome: both LCBs cross zero. The crossover is not statistically confirmed.

what_this_is_and_is_not.IS: the crossover SHAPE is present in the point estimates: pi_A beats pi_B on pole A (+0.083) and pi_B beats pi_A on pole B (+0.063). The ranking reverses in the direction the environment demands.
what_this_is_and_is_not.IS_NOT: statistically distinguishable from evaluation noise at n=192. The frozen gate is the lower bound, not the point estimate, and both bounds include zero.
what_this_is_and_is_not.not_a_near_miss_to_be_argued_around: no extension, no alternative estimator, no re-run. The block is spent.

why_it_failed_the_discordant_structure.mechanism: Var(d) = D/n - delta^2, so for a fixed net advantage the evidence strengthens as the discordant count D FALLS. Here the nets (+16, +12) were assembled from large, nearly balanced disagreement sets (55 vs 39; 47 vs 35). The policies disagree on roughly half the seeds and split those disagreements almost evenly, which is exactly the high-variance construction.
why_it_failed_the_discordant_structure.boundary_reference: at delta ~ +0.0625 the PASS/FAIL boundary sits near D ~ 30-40. Observed D was 82-94, roughly triple.
why_it_failed_the_discordant_structure.reading: the specialists genuinely differ, but they win and lose against each other on largely interchangeable seeds rather than on a consistent subset. That is weak complementarity, not strong complementarity.

frozen_ladder_consequence.rule: R2 crossover fails -> STOP. This is a learning result, not an environment result.
frozen_ladder_consequence.R3_not_run: oracle repertoire value is NOT computed. R3 is gated behind R2.
frozen_ladder_consequence.latent_not_unlocked: no latent-conditioned policy may be trained. Compressing two policies whose complementarity is indistinguishable from noise would reproduce the original latent-collapse problem.
frozen_ladder_consequence.what_it_does_NOT_overturn: V3_STRATEGIC_DEMAND remains VALIDATED and TWO_WAY_PAYOFF_REVERSAL remains CONFIRMED. Those were established with SCRIPTED policies. The environment still demands two strategies; this result says PPO under the frozen R1 recipe did not learn them strongly enough to distinguish from noise.

the_generalist_row_is_the_interesting_fi.observation: the generalist is markedly worse than either specialist on pole A (0.365 vs 0.484-0.568) and worse than pi_B on pole B. Its two-pole mean trails the oracle pairing by ~0.135.
the_generalist_row_is_the_interesting_fi.status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. R3 was not run, this quantity was not computed under the R3 protocol, and it is NOT a repertoire-value claim.
the_generalist_row_is_the_interesting_fi.why_recorded: it is the strongest hint about WHERE the learning difficulty sits: pole A appears to be the hard context, and the generalist handles it worst. Any redesign should start there.
the_generalist_row_is_the_interesting_fi.caution: it is also consistent with the generalist simply being undertrained relative to its harder task, since 2M steps split across two opponents is 1M of effective exposure per pole -- the same budget each specialist got for a single pole.

candidate_explanations_not_tested: 1M steps per specialist may be insufficient for sharp specialization under M1; G0-V5's competence-at-1M evidence came from RULESET_V2 against a 7-opponent mixture, which was recorded as a risk when T was frozen
one seed per policy means policy-level variation is unmeasured; the observed deltas could be seed effects rather than treatment effects
the poles may demand strategies that are close in policy space even though they are far apart in scripted-response space
deterministic evaluation of a stochastic policy may compress behavioural differences
prohibited_from_here: re-running R2 on a fresh block to get a luckier draw
lowering the gate or switching to a one-sided test
computing R3 and reporting it as if R2 had passed
changing the V3 benchmark, which is frozen and not implicated
